DeleteHpoExperiment.description_en: Deletes a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment. After you delete the experiment, you cannot obtain the data about the experiment and its trials by using the Get or List API operations
DeleteHpoExperiment.description_zh: 删除一个HPO实验。删除后，实验和它的trials数据都不会再通过Get/List API返回

GetHpoExperiment.description_en: Queries the information about a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment, including the status and configuration of the experiment, and the status of its trials
GetHpoExperiment.description_zh: 获取一个HPO实验的信息，包括状态、配置、以及所属trials的状态等数据

GetHpoTrial.description_en: Queries information about a trial in a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment
GetHpoTrial.description_zh: 获取一个HPO实验里一个指定Trial的信息

GetServiceIdentityRole.description_en: GetServiceIdentityRole, return role name if SLR exists, empty otherwise
GetServiceIdentityRole.description_zh: GetServiceIdentityRole, return role name if SLR exists, empty otherwise

ListHpoExperimentLogs.description_en: Queries the content of a log file for a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment
ListHpoExperimentLogs.description_zh: 显示一个HPO实验指定log的内容

ListHpoExperiments.description_en: Queries information about a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment that meets specific requirements
ListHpoExperiments.description_zh: 查询符合条件的HPO实验信息

ListHpoTrialCommands.description_en: Queries the command output of a trial in a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment. A trial of an HPO experiment runs one or more commands in sequence based on the command set specified in the configuration. You can call this API operation to obtain the output of these commands
ListHpoTrialCommands.description_zh: HPO一个trial会按配置里的命令集，顺序运行一个或多个后台命令。这些命令在执行时的输出可以通过这个API返回

ListHpoTrialLogNames.description_en: Lists the names of all log files of the specific trial in a specific hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment
ListHpoTrialLogNames.description_zh: 返回指定的HPO实验里指定的trial所拥有的所有的log文件的名称

ListHpoTrialLogs.description_en: Lists the content of a specific log file of a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) trial by pages
ListHpoTrialLogs.description_zh: 分页显示一个hpo trial的一个指定日治的内容

ListHpoTrials.description_en: Returns all the trials for the specified experiment ID

RestartHpoTrials.description_en: Restarts failed trials in an hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment. The system extracts the configuration of the hyperparameters of a specific trial. If none of the trials that use this configuration are successful in the experiment, the system restarts trials by using this configuration
RestartHpoTrials.description_zh: 重启一个HPO实验里失败的trials。对于指定的trial，提取它使用的超参配置。如果该实验所有使用这个配置的trials都没有成功过，那么用这个配置重新启动一个trial

StopHpoExperiment.description_en: Stops a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment, including its trials and the backend tasks
StopHpoExperiment.description_zh: 完全停止一个指定的AutoML HPO实验，包括停止该实验所属的trials，和这些trials所依赖的后台任务

StopHpoTrials.description_en: Stops specific trials in a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment and the backend tasks of the trials
StopHpoTrials.description_zh: 停止一个HPO实验里指定的trials，以及这些trials对应的后台任务

UpdateHpoExperiment.description_en: Updates the configurations of a running hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment. After you update the experiment, the experiment continues to run based on the new configurations
UpdateHpoExperiment.description_zh: 更新一个正在运行中的HPO实验的设置。更新成功后，该实验将按照新的设置继续执行
